note: Both full jumps were tracked and refused: the flights are not ballistic. Fitted gravity comes out 21 % (male) and 11 % (female) too high, and the spiders slow down sideways; for the male the extra acceleration points almost straight against the motion, the direction air drag would have on a spider of a few milligrams. The ballistic speed estimate is therefore not reported. The caption 'Playback 4x faster' is read as one video frame = 4 camera frames; the gravity check is the independent test of that reading (a wrong factor would move g by its square). The magnified take-offs show no landing target, so no gap can be measured. Several printed numbers equal the table value truncated rather than rounded; this is noted, not judged.
